fact: TechCabal says the Tax Identification Number, issued by the Nigeria Revenue Service and the Joint Revenue Board, is generated from the National Identification Number for individuals.
The Nigeria Revenue Service article says a system-generated 13-digit Tax ID is automatically generated when a new company registers, and existing businesses retrieve theirs from the NRS Portal.
The article says a company's CAC RC number functions as its NRS identifier and the NRS database is integrated with the CAC from 1 January 2026, so no separate TIN application is needed.
The article says an individual's National Identification Number serves as the NRS identifier, giving a 13-digit Tax ID.
The article states TaxPro Max, the exclusive channel for taxpayer transactions with FIRS, enables taxpayer registration.
